findings.detail: Source loneliness passage: Russian grammar corrected to 'Об одиночестве'; rechecked in adjacent dialogue.
Source Caleb-as-exposed-target passage: corrected feminine agreement to 'у всех на виду — лёгкая мишень'; subject and threat maintained.
Source Arian's factual retort: replaced 'Это должно быть правдой' with direct 'Это правда'; confirmed tone and modality.
Source Caleb's impossibly bright eyes: restored brightness (невероятно яркими) instead of an invented eye-color claim.
Source 'He storms toward the door': restored forceful movement 'Он бросается к двери' without changing object or sequence.
